The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

OnMed runs CareStation kiosks across schools, workplaces and other everyday locations, each streaming live clinician video, connected diagnostic devices and pharmacy fulfillment into a single encounter.

Even where each CareStation's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same patient and encounter record as the network scales.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a healthtech company OnMed's size spends on technology.
